time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0
units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed
description: Static shot of a calm lake at dusk. A small wooden rowing boat with two seated people (dark silhouettes) moves steadily from right to left across the middle of the frame, bow pointing left, slowly drifting towards the camera (apparent size grows ~16%). Far shoreline with treelines on the horizon, reeds in the bottom-left foreground.

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the horizon/treeline band (rows 300-470) vs frame 0: |dx|,|dy| <= 0.18 px over all frames (scene/tracks/camera_shift.csv)

objects.name: boat
objects.aka: rowing boat / rowboat / canoe with two people
objects.distinguish: only vessel in the scene; dark hull silhouette in mid-frame, bow (pointed, raised) on the LEFT, stern on the right
objects.reference_point: cx_hull, cy_hull = centre of hull box (bow tip to stern, gunwale-top to waterline); also bbox centre and mask centroid
objects.motion: leftward (-x), nearly constant: centre moves -328.5 px over 219 frames (mean -1.50 px/frame); per-frame pixel rate grows from ~-1.36 to ~-1.62 px/frame as the boat gets nearer; vertical centre steady (cy 519.5-522.5)

objects.name: person_left_rower
objects.aka: rower / front person / person on the left
objects.distinguish: left (bow-side) seated figure, holds the oars; at frame 0 at x~849
objects.size_px: visible height from waterline (y 540) to head top ~56-59 px; above the gunwale ~22-25 px; seated, legs hidden

objects.name: person_right_stern
objects.aka: passenger / person on the right / stern person
objects.distinguish: right (stern-side) seated figure, slightly hunched; at frame 0 at x~947
objects.size_px: visible height from waterline to head top ~52-56 px

objects.name: oars
objects.distinguish: thin dark poles held by the left rower, dipping into the water on both sides; too thin to segment reliably

objects.name: boat_reflection
objects.distinguish: dark mirror image of boat and people directly below the waterline (y > 540); NOT part of the boat

objects.name: far_shore_left_treeline
objects.note: visual estimate from frame 0, cut by left frame edge

objects.name: far_shore_right_treeline
objects.note: visual estimate, cut by right frame edge; low distant shore between 720 and 1480 at y~415-450

objects.name: horizon_waterline
objects.image_position: far shore meets water at y~440 (left) to ~455 (right); nearly horizontal

objects.name: lake_water
objects.note: fills y>440; ripples/sun reflections move but are not objects

objects.name: sky_clouds
objects.note: clouds y<350, essentially static over 7 s

events.event: boat already moving left at frame 0 and keeps moving through the last frame (no start/stop, no direction change)

perspective: nominally 2D (side view). Boat heads left and also slowly approaches the camera: hull length 212 -> 247 px (+16.5%), hull height 34 -> 40 px, so pixel scale changes ~16% across the clip. Annotator convention: one scale factor from the prior object's pixel length (e.g. boat bow-to-stern length).
